Integrate gridded intensity over one time period

Source: R/integrate_intensity_period.R
integrate_intensity_period.Rd

Numerically integrates background and triggering intensity snapshots returned by background_trigger_grid(), using the trapezoidal rule.

Usage

integrate_intensity_period(grid, start, end)

Arguments

grid

A list returned by background_trigger_grid().

start

Initial model time, in days.

end

Final model time, in days. Must be greater than start.

Value

A list with days, x, y, inside and snapshots, compatible with plot_intensity_snapshot(). The single snapshot contains temporally integrated bg and tr matrices. Its time identifier is start. Additional fields statistic, period and integration describe the aggregation.

Details

Integration is performed independently at each spatial grid location. Actual time differences are used, so equally spaced times are not required.

Both period boundaries must be available in grid$days. No temporal interpolation or extrapolation is performed.

This function integrates sampled intensity surfaces. It does not reevaluate the fitted model or implement event-aware quadrature. Accuracy should be assessed by refining the evaluation times, particularly near triggering discontinuities.

Examples

# \donttest{
# A quick fit to one year of the bundled simulated data: a coarse grid, a
# coarse triggering-kernel grid and two EM iterations keep it to a few
# seconds. Real analyses need finer settings and more iterations.
cache_dir <- tempfile("spHawkes_marks_")
fit <- fit_semihawkes(
  sim_events, sim_region,
  date_col  = "date",
  end_date  = "2022-01-01",
  cell_size = 1000,
  cache_dir = cache_dir,
  trigger_spatial_args = list(x_range = 2000, x_step = 250),
  trigger_window_dist  = 2000,
  n_iter  = 2,
  verbose = FALSE,
  seed    = 1
)
#> The modelled study period ends on 2021-12-29, the day after the last event. `end_date` (2022-01-01) is used only to select events and to label outputs.
grid <- background_trigger_grid(fit, sim_region, cell_size = 500,
                                days = 0:30)
january <- integrate_intensity_period(grid, start = 0, end = 30)
str(january, max.level = 1)
#> List of 8
#>  $ days       : num 0
#>  $ x          : num [1:17] 0 500 1000 1500 2000 2500 3000 3500 4000 4500 ...
#>  $ y          : num [1:17] 0 500 1000 1500 2000 2500 3000 3500 4000 4500 ...
#>  $ inside     : logi [1:289] TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE ...
#>  $ snapshots  :List of 1
#>  $ statistic  : chr "time_integral"
#>  $ period     : Named num [1:2] 0 30
#>   ..- attr(*, "names")= chr [1:2] "start" "end"
#>  $ integration:List of 3
# }
